assets.headers:
# Workers static assets (https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/static-assets/headers/).
# Vite names build files by content hash: cache them for good. index.html keeps the default
# (revalidated), so a deploy is picked up on the next load.
/assets/*
  Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable

# Studio is the deployment's most privileged origin: never framed, no plugins, no <base> swaps,
# no MIME sniffing. The admin Worker sends the same on the shell it serves for client routes.
/*
  Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'
  X-Frame-Options: DENY
  X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
  Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin
  Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000

/_astro/*
  Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable

# Font files never change under a path: a new font set gets a new directory (/fonts/v2/…).
# Cached for a year, the browser uses them on every reload without asking the server, so the
# text is drawn in its font from the first paint instead of swapping in later.
/fonts/v1/*
  Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable

/_cloudhal/*
  Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable
